name: MINIKrea2 RTX-EZ Base
desc: Private ComfyUI base template for MINIKrea2 / RTX-EZ setup on Vast.ai.
readme:
# MINIKrea2 RTX-EZ Base

Private Vast.ai template for ComfyUI-based MINIKrea2 / RTX-EZ work.

What this template does:
- Uses `vastai/comfy:v0.30.0-cuda-13.2-py312`
- Keeps ComfyUI and Vast app wiring
- Starts in Jupyter + SSH mode
- Sets clean defaults for ComfyUI arguments and workspace paths
- Leaves heavy workflow bootstrap to follow-up provisioning or a future custom image

Why this exists:
- Avoid repeating the same template settings manually
- Keep a stable base before moving to a heavier custom image
- Preserve direct ComfyUI/Jupyter/SSH access while we harden provisioning

Notes:
- ComfyUI is the required app.
- Vast `api-wrapper` is optional for direct SSH-tunnel usage, but the base image may still expose it for portal integration.
- If stock provisioning still wastes time on default model downloads, the next step is either a custom `PROVISIONING_SCRIPT` URL or a fully custom image.
env: -p 1111:11111 -p 8080:8080 -p 8384:8384 -p 72299:72299 -p 8188:18188 -p 8288:8288 -p 10100:10100 -p 10200:10200 -e COMFYUI_ARGS="--disable-auto-launch --disable-xformers --port 18188 --enable-cors-header" -e COMFYUI_API_BASE="http://localhost:18188" -e OPEN_BUTTON_PORT="1111" -e JUPYTER_DIR="/" -e DATA_DIRECTORY="/workspace/" -e WORKSPACE="/workspace" -e HF_XET_HIGH_PERFORMANCE="1" -e CIVITAI_BASE_URL="https://civitai.red"
